body:
Tonight was a night to remember the rest of my life. It was a cold night with snow on the ground. I was at my one friends house waiting for alcohol to come. I was a newbie with weed at the time so I bought a bag of just shake of this kid for 30 bucks. It was maybe 2 grams. We went to my other friends house where the party was. All was fine and dandy. We smoked in my friends garage out of a brand new acryllic bong we had just ordered from the internet.  I also was drinking beers along with 30 other people in the house.  I saved most of the weed for my friends house for after the party. Then it crashed from there. One of my friends said the one word that everybody dispises the most, COPS!!
I packed all my shit in my backpack and went to the backyard where I see 10 or so kids jumping the fence.  I see a person trying to get in my friends backyard so I jump the fence also. Now 10 of us are in another persons backyard drunk off their asses. Nobody could get the gate open. Neighbors were looking at us and people were being so loud when I finnally opened the fence. We went out on the street nd groups of people split up. I was with 4 of my friends and we were walking down the street. My friend could not walk because he was plastured off his ass, so me and my other friend carryed him down the street. My one friend walked ahead of us. Just then a cop comes driving down he street and tells us to stop.
He told us to come to the cop car. He asked us what we were doing and we told him we were just walking around. Then another cop car came. It was my old baseball coach which was now a cop. He searched me and found the baggy of weed. He asked if I was drinking and I said no, he then shook my backpack and all you hear were bottles rattling. My one friend had a pipe on him also. The piss drunk friend and my other friend had nothing but a bottle of whipped cream on him which the cop asked if he was huffing it. Me and my one friend with the pipe were handcuffed and put in the car. We were then brought down to the station. By this time I felt like total shit and didnt know what to do. By this time they had my backpack and they opened it. I had 6 bottles of liquer, a bong, a pipe, 5 packs of EZ widers and a paintball gun. The cop thought he was funny and asked if the bong was a penis enlarger. Then he commented and said they had to further examine the peice later (insinduating that he was going to smoke I guess) they gave me my paintball gun back and my papers.
Then my dad had to pick me up because I was under age. He was very pissed off and I was gonna get my ass handed to me. Yhat was a crazy night. Not a good night but crazy.
